member.name: P:KineticaRT.Channels.INumericChannel.Units
member.summary: Gets or sets the units string for a channel.

member.remarks: This property is normally used to put a units label on display controls such as the Dial.

member.name: P:KineticaRT.Channels.INumericChannel.DecimalDigits
member.summary: Gets or sets the number of decimal digits to be displayed if displayed in number format or fixed point format.
member.value: The number of decimal digits to be displayed.

member.name: P:KineticaRT.Channels.INumericChannel.Minimum
member.summary: Gets or sets the minimum value of channel.
member.value: The minimum value of the channel.
member.remarks:
This value is normally used for setting the minimum value on a display scale.
No limit checking is performed so the actual Value may be lower.

member.name: P:KineticaRT.Channels.INumericChannel.Maximum
member.summary: Gets or sets the maximum value of channel.
member.value: The maximum balue of the channel.
member.remarks:
This value is normally used for setting the maximum value on a display scale.
No limit checking is performed so the actual Value may be higher.

member.name: P:KineticaRT.Channels.INumericChannel.Format
member.summary: Gets or sets the format of the channel when viewed as text.
member.value: A string describing the display format of the channel.
member.remarks:
The following formats can be used:
"C" - Currency
"D" - Decimal
"E" - Exponential
"F" - Fixed Point
"G" - General
"N" - Number
"P" - Percentage
"X" - Hexadecimal
"0.00" - Zero padding
"#.##" - Blank padding
